entities.name: Supplied TERF1 protein
observations: 436 aa sequence; estimated molecular weight 49.94 kDa, theoretical pI 6.28, GRAVY -0.783, and charge at pH 7 of -3.59.
Sequence matches human TERF1 with 82.3% identity over 100% query and target coverage; E-value 4.53e-244.
Contains a TRF domain at residues 73–264 and a C-terminal Myb DNA-binding domain at residues 377–424.
Functional assignment is supported by strong homology, but exact organism-specific behavior remains inferred from reference proteins.

entities.name: TERF1
observations: Human TERF1/ telomeric repeat-binding factor 1 binds double-stranded 5'-TTAGGG-3' telomeric repeats.
TERF1 is a component of the shelterin complex and negatively regulates telomere length and telomeric DNA replication.
TERF1 forms homodimers and interacts with POT1, TINF2, and tankyrases within shelterin-related assemblies.
Reported localizations include nucleus, telomere, chromosome, cytoskeleton, and mitotic spindle.

entities.name: TRF domain
observations: Pfam TRF domain PF08558.17 occurs at residues 73–264 in the supplied sequence; i-Evalue 7e-38.

entities.name: Myb DNA-binding domain
observations: Pfam Myb_DNA-binding PF00249.38 occurs at residues 377–424; i-Evalue 1.4e-11. A related Myb_DNA-bind_6 hit spans residues 382–423.
This C-terminal Myb-like domain supports sequence-specific telomeric DNA binding.

entities.name: Shelterin complex
observations: TERF1 is an annotated component of the shelterin/telosome complex that protects chromosome ends and regulates telomere length.
